answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a garden spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a dune header. Producing 24 answers an epoch thus costs 59 real forward passes, and the knoll record lets any auditor recompute the check. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
